# Coursera DL — Course Archiving Tool

> High-performance cross-platform desktop application powered by Rust, Tauri v2, and React for archiving enrolled Coursera courses, HD videos, lecture notes, and materials for offline personal study.

- **Website**: https://courseradl.github.io/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/courseradl/coursera-dl-gui
- **License**: GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)
- **Supported Platforms**: macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), Windows (x64), Linux (AppImage & deb)

## Core Capabilities
- **Desktop GUI**: Native desktop interface built on Tauri v2 and React.
- **Video & Materials Archiving**: Downloads 720p/1080p videos, lecture slides, course PDFs, and multilingual subtitles (.vtt).
- **Specialization Support**: Automatic discovery and batch archiving across nested syllabus modules and complete specializations.
- **Privacy First**: Authenticates locally using session cookies (`CAUTH`). No user credentials or personal data are transmitted to third-party servers.

## Quick Start & Usage Flow
1. Log in to Coursera in your web browser.
2. Export your session cookies (`CAUTH`).
3. Open Coursera DL and paste your session cookie into the local authentication field.
4. Select active course modules, specify output folder, and start archiving.

## Development & Build Instructions
- Prerequisites: Node.js (>=18), Rust toolchain (cargo), and pnpm / npm.
- Clone: `git clone https://github.com/courseradl/coursera-dl-gui.git`
- Dev mode: `pnpm install && pnpm tauri dev`
- Build binary: `pnpm tauri build`
